text:
Sophie L: Quick sync: We discovered a parameter rename in the v2 SDK (`stop_sequences` -> `stoppers`) and a concurrent model swap that changes default tokenization. Need a tiny migration note + example updates across py/ts/go. Can someone own the cross-lang PR?
Jamal T: I can own the cross-lang PR. Will update examples and add a short breakage note for tokenization diffs.
Priya K: I'll audit the Python snippets. I already found two notebooks using `stop_sequences` in the examples folder.
Leo N: I'll check the Go and internal samples. Also want to add a CI smoke test to catch the parameter name mismatch.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR checklist requires all snippet changes to include runnable examples and test output.
Sophie L: Add a one-paragraph migration blurb at the top of the page: mention param rename, tokenization caveat, and link to alias map. Keep it <120 chars for the banner.
Jamal T: Proposed banner: "v1 shim retiring — update SDK calls: `stop_sequences` -> `stoppers`; re-run prompt smoke-tests due to tokenizer changes." Thoughts?
Priya K: Short and clear. For the Python snippet, propose we show both old and new calls inline so users can copy-paste.

```
# old (v1)
# res = client.generate(model='redwood-chat', input=prompt, stop_sequences=['\n\n'])

# new (v2)
res = client.chat.create(model='redwood-chat-v2', messages=[{'role':'user','content':prompt}], stoppers=['\n\n'])
```

Leo N: Nice. In Go we'll need a small code comment about streaming framing differences that affected our HTML-escaped snippets. I'll add a note: "If your output contains HTML tags, check streaming framing or set streaming=false for deterministic output." 
Sophie L: Good call. Also include a one-line redirect note: old docs URLs under /v1/ will be redirected but put a redirect grace period of 30 days in the banner.
link-bot: Found 3 doc links pointing to /v1/ endpoints in the search and integration guides. I'll create a link-check report attached to the PR.
Jamal T: I'll add a small QA checklist in the PR description: 1) run snippet in py/ts/go, 2) verify stoppers param accepted, 3) compare token counts on a 50-item prompt sample, 4) run streaming smoke test.
Priya K: FYI — tokenization diffs: one of our test prompts showed +18% tokens after the model swap. Should call that out as "may be >10% in edge cases".
Sophie L: Add wording: "Tokenization differences may exceed 10% for prompts with special whitespace/HTML; re-evaluate prompt costs."
Leo N: Ops asked for a tiny rollback section: how to pin model alias in Console and how to change SDK to use the pinned version. I'll add console steps and an example SDK flag: model: 'redwood-chat@2026-02-15'.

```
// pin example (JS):
const resp = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat@2026-02-15', messages })
```

Jamal T: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399  includes py/ts/go snippets, banner copy, redirect note, QA checklist, and link-check report. Assigning reviewers: @Priya K, @Leo N, @Sophie L.
Priya K: Reviewing now. Left one nit: update the Python example to import the correct client class name (old notebook used ClientV1).
Leo N: Found one Go example that still constructs a `GenerateRequest` object; will replace with ChatCreate.
docs-bot: CI triggered for PR #4399  lint + snippet-smoke-tests + linkcheck.
link-bot: Link report attached: 3 stale /v1/ endpoints, 1 broken external CDN link in integrations.md.
Sophie L: Thanks. If snippet-smoke-tests are flaky for streaming, fallback is to set streaming:false and mention streaming differences in Troubleshooting.
Jamal T: Noted. Will add troubleshooting bullets: streaming flakiness, tokenizer diffs, and rollback steps.
Priya K: Approved the Python changes. Left a small suggestion to include a tokenizer debug command for consumers.
Leo N: Approved Go changes after small rename.
Sophie L: Merging after CI green. Ops, please wait for the Monday canary run before flipping the deprecation banner.

link-bot: Post-merge action: created redirect PR for /v1/ -> /migrations/v1-to-v2 which will expire in 30 days.

Sophie L: TL;DR: owner=Jamal, reviewers=Priya/Leo, action items=rename param note, update snippets across languages, QA checklist, redirect rules, rollback steps. Target: deprecate v1 shim in 1 week pending canary. :white_check_mark:
